method.sizeChart: The shop's own printed body chart (size guide, cm table), restricted to the sizes the product offers, sizeChartType 'body'. Letter sizes use the shop's letter table. Trousers get the shop's body inside leg for their length tag.
method.baseSize: The size the model wears, printed on the product page (the photographed size, stated by the shop). For letter-sized products: the letter the shop's chart maps that size to. Otherwise the middle of the range (our default, flagged).
method.fabric: The product page's 'Fabric Main:' composition through resolveFabricText/fabricFromText. Lining and trims are listed as warnings (one fabric per payload). The fabric-group tag is never used as a composition.
method.lengths: The product page's 'Wearing length' (read only inside the product's own block, never from cross-sell drawers), checked against a plausibility range per category and length band; never used for trousers.
method.images: images.json: every image looked at and classified by hand; sha256 of the file as downloaded.

trueToSizeScore (from past return data) narrows or widens the size tie band; 0.8 is assumed.
colorways let the user try every colour the shop sells; only the primary colour is shown when absent.
styleTags (0..1 per taste axis) override the inferred style of the item in the swipe deck.
